this exam! I live in shadows—a ninja!

and destroy you! Prepare to be the victim of

next exam!

I will be the proctor of your final exam!

strives to grow stronger is a precious ideal.

That is why I respect you—because you
have these things. Congratulations!
You passed!

in my jinbei. I’ll win while you’re distracted!

festival?
